{{Ophiuchus}}
Ophiuchus 14 is the 350th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 14th day of Ophiuchus, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 50, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 13宮14日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 350|Chapter 350]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152369}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Sunday]]
